## Overview

This project was a business strategy report on a specific case study: 
Californian battery start-up, Lyten’s acquisition of bankrupt Swedish battery manufacturer, 
Northvolt. The report had three main aspects to address: firstly, what were the 
main strategic issues that Lyten were facing in the wake of their acquisition. 
Secondly, determine whether their acquisition reflected a coherent internationalization strategy 
or premature global scaling. And finally, evaluate the trade-off between geopolitical alignment 
and commercial flexibility presented in the case.
